CSM Technologies Lists Flat, Shares Dip After Debut

CSM Technologies made its stock market debut with its share price opening at the issue price, resulting in a flat listing. The company's shares later experienced a 5% dip, hitting the lower circuit. The Initial Public Offering (IPO) saw a muted subscription rate of 1.36 times, with the company intending to use the raised funds for growth and working capital.
